p='src/intake.py'
s=open(p).read()
old=s[s.index('# Some providers'):s.index('class Intake')]
new='''# The provider's Idempotency-Key identifies a payout across retries; retries
# carry a new event id (e.g. po_1844 -> po_1844.2), so the event id is only a
# fallback when no key was sent.
# Northwind has historically been keyed on the first 8 chars of its header;
# kept as-is so its existing replay identities don't change.
SHORT_KEY_PROVIDERS = frozenset({"northwind"})
_KEY_PREFIX = 8


def storage_key(hook: Webhook) -> str:
    # Choose the idempotency identity for this delivery
    if not hook.idempotency_key:
        return hook.event_id
    if hook.provider in SHORT_KEY_PROVIDERS:
        return hook.idempotency_key[:_KEY_PREFIX]
    return hook.idempotency_key


'''
s=s.replace(old,new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cat >> tests/test_intake.py <<'EOF'


def test_harbor_retry_with_a_new_event_id_is_not_applied_twice():
    intake = Intake()
    first = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    again = intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1844.2", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6"))
    assert first.applied is True
    assert again.applied is False
    assert again.duplicate is True
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 18_000
    assert len(intake.ledger.entries) == 1


def test_distinct_harbor_keys_sharing_a_prefix_both_settle():
    intake = Intake()
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_1", "8f3c1a9e0b27d4c6", amount=18_000))
    intake.apply(hook("harbor", "po_2", "8f3c1a9effffffff", amount=2_000))
    assert intake.ledger.balance("acct-44") == 20_000
EOF
python -m pytest -q
